narrations.description: Every recording of the meditation as a playable URL, the default voice first. Empty when nothing is recorded; null when recordings exist but cannot be signed just now (see narratedVoices).

artwork.description: The painting the set is shown with: its own, or else its author's portrait. Null when neither is publishable. Field included by default.

author.description: The author the set is shown with: its own, or else the one its meditations agree on. Field included by default.

source.description: The source the set is shown with: its own, or else the one its meditations agree on. Field included by default.

artwork.description: The mystery's painting, with its attribution. Null until one is uploaded and published with alt text and a licence. Field included by default.

key.description: The app's key for the mystery, `<category>_<order>`: `joyful_1`. Every section of the Rosary's content that is keyed by a mystery uses it; the id is the server's and differs between databases. Field included by default.

default.description: The voice heard when a client names none. Exactly one offered voice is. Field included by default.

replaced_by.description: For a retired voice, the slug of the voice a request for it is served by. Field included by default.

attributes.description: An attributes object for a rosary_content

categories.description: The five categories of mysteries, in the order the app presents them: names, the label of each mystery by position, Hail Marys per decade, whether the Fatima Prayer is said, and the Seven Sorrows' graces.

forms.description: The Rosary's forms (the Scriptural Rosary, the Rosary Said Aloud), the Audio and Counting choices in their words, and what each form's page offers.

guided_rosary.description: "Your First Rosary": the Rosary a step at a time for each of the four sets, every step tied to the bead under the fingers, with the parts of a rosary as a beginner learns them.

labels.description: The meditation set labels, what the app calls each and the kinds of meditation they describe.

learn.description: The How to Pray course: three lessons, then "Your First Rosary", with the steps of the Rosary and the prayers said at each, how often each prayer comes round, Montfort's counsel and the questions beginners ask.

milestones.description: The streak's named devotional milestones, by days ascending. One is reached when a day's first prayer brings the streak to exactly its days.

mysteries.description: The 27 mysteries in the order they are prayed, by category (Joyful, Sorrowful, Glorious, Luminous, the Seven Sorrows) and then by place, each keyed `<category>_<order>`, with its fruit, key verse and the spoken Rosary's announcement.

prayers.description: The twelve prayers of the Rosary and the Seven Sorrows chaplet, in the order they are said, in English and Latin.

quotes.description: The daily quotations on the Rosary, and the rule that chooses one for a day: the home screen's, and a second one for after praying, half the catalogue away.

reminders.description: The daily reminders' messages in their groups, what each intention draws from, and the numbers of the rule that picks a week of them.

schedule.description: Which mysteries a day calls for, on both weekly schedules, as rules to apply offline: each weekday's set, Sunday's by season, every Lent and Advent from last year to three years ahead, the home grid's order and the days each set is prayed in words. The day is the device's calendar day, turning at midnight, not the prayer day that turns at four in the morning.

script.description: The order a Rosary is said in, as templates a client expands offline: the Rosary's and the chaplet's steps, the optional prayers after the Rosary and the strand's beads. GET /api/v2/rosary-script expands them.

updated_at.description: When the content last changed. Field included by default.

verses.description: The Scriptural Rosary's verses as text, each mystery's in bead order: ten to a mystery, seven to a sorrow. The words the spoken Rosary says.

version.description: Fingerprints everything the document serves: a device whose copy has the same version holds every current word. Compare it; do not parse it. Field included by default.

relationships.description: A relationships object for a rosary_content

attributes.description: An attributes object for a rosary_script

extras.description: The optional prayers said, in the order they are said. Field included by default.

orders.description: The mysteries' orders, one per decade, in prayer order. Field included by default.

steps.description: Every step, in the order it is said. Field included by default.

relationships.description: A relationships object for a rosary_script
